name: HydraFacial Signature Luxe
description: An award-winning multi-step treatment that cleanses, evenly exfoliates, and extracts impurities while simultaneously infusing skin with nourishing peptides, antioxidants, and hyaluronic acid.

name: Medical Microneedling (Dermapen)
description: A medically graded collagen induction therapy that utilizes sterile micro-needles to stimulate cellular renewal. Restores elasticity, minimizes acne scars, and smooths wrinkles.

name: Fractional Laser Resurfacing
description: An advanced laser treatment targeting superficial layers to vaporize damaged skin cells. Promotes powerful tissue remodeling, curing severe texture issues and uneven hyperpigmentation.

name: Clarifying Clinical Peel
description: A medical-grade salicylic and glycolic acid peel specifically designed to regulate sebum production, dissolve deep blackheads, and calm active inflammatory acne.
